title: Levels of biodiversity
back: Rauwolfia reserpine; Western vs Eastern Ghats amphibians; India vs Norway ecosystems.

title: How many species?
legend: who = Robert May made the estimate
back: India: 2.4% of land, 8.1% of species, ~45,000 plant species; one of 12 mega-diversity countries.

title: Species–area relationship
back: Humboldt. Rectangular hyperbola; a straight line on log–log axes. Frugivorous birds and mammals: Z = 1.15.

title: Species–area curve
back: Left: S vs A levels off. Right: log S vs log A is straight; slope = Z.

title: Latitudinal gradient
back: Colombia | New York (41° N) | Greenland (71° N). Tropics: long time, steady climate, more sunlight.

title: Rivet popper hypothesis
back: Paul Ehrlich. Tilman's plots: more species → more stable biomass and higher productivity.

title: The Evil Quartet
back: Amazon cleared | Steller's sea cow | Nile perch in Lake Victoria | host and parasite. Habitat loss is the most important.

title: Extinction numbers
legend: now = 100–1,000 times faster than before humans
back: 338 vertebrates, 359 invertebrates, 87 plants. We may be in a sixth extinction.

title: In situ vs ex situ
tex: \begin{gathered}\text{in situ: hotspots,}\\\text{parks, sacred groves}\\\text{ex situ: zoos,}\\\text{seed banks, cryo}\end{gathered}
back: NCERT figures: 14 biosphere reserves, 90 national parks, 448 sanctuaries; 34 hotspots, 3 in India.

title: International efforts
back: Biodiversity knows no political boundaries, so conservation is a collective responsibility.

title: HOAC
back: Habitat loss, Over-exploitation, Alien invasions, Co-extinctions.
